description: I want this repository to be installable into any repository through a set of commands, comparably to publishing a tool on npm. I want to determine how to do it and whether making it installable migrates and adds all files. I want the work to follow the harness flow by creating the sprint, epic, task specifications, and planning needed to deliver this capability, because that flow was not followed earlier.
acceptance_criteria: A validated discovery dossier preserves the original Spanish request and an attested canonical English representation.
Research-RDD artifacts document authoritative packaging and tool-distribution contracts, the domain model, candidate decisions, and observable delivery scenarios.
A draft epic, task specifications, and proposed sprint identify dependencies, risks, file surfaces, and explicit human approval gates without materializing implementation tasks.
The planning records an explicit safe ownership and migration boundary for target repositories and does not implement or publish an installer.

request.original_text: Quiero que este repositorio sea instalable en cualquier repositorio con una serie de comandos, de forma comparable a publicar una herramienta en npm, y quiero saber cómo hacerlo y si se migran y agregan todos los archivos al hacerlo instalable. Quiero que trabajes como corresponde creando sprint, epic, task specs y planning, todo lo necesario para realizar esta tarea, y quiero activar ese flujo porque antes no se siguió el flujo del harnes.
